system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided simdjson codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the simdjson codebase on branch branch-03. Identify the specific regressions introduced in on-demand parsing, streaming behavior, and stage1 empty-input handling. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md

rubric.criterion: Identifies the padding assumption bug in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/parser-inl.h in parser::iterate(std::string&) where padded_string_view(json, json.size()) is used without extending capacity, leading to insufficient padding when capacity == size

Identifies the padding check bypass in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/parser-inl.h in parser::iterate_many(std::string&) where it forwards to the pointer overload, skipping the padded_string_view padding validation

Identifies that in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/document_stream-inl.h, document_stream::next_document resets doc.iter._depth and doc.iter._root but never resets doc.iter._string_buf_loc, even though json_iterator::unescape writes into parser->string_buf and json_iterator::rewind explicitly resets _string_buf_loc to parser->string_buf.get(); in streaming we never call rewind, so without resetting _string_buf_loc between documents, unescaped strings from later documents append into the previous buffer region, leading to corruption/overflow after enough documents

Identifies the streaming flag omission bug in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/document_stream-inl.h in document_stream::start where doc.iter._streaming is not set to true, causing root checks to run in non-streaming mode and mis-handle streams

Identifies the iterator re-anchor removal in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/document_stream-inl.h in document_stream::next where json_iterator is not re-anchored after a new batch, causing pointers to reference the previous buffer window

Identifies the end-of-stream misclassification in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/document_stream-inl.h in document_stream::run_stage1: when remaining == batch_size and batch_start + batch_size == len (the true final chunk), the code goes to the streaming_partial path instead of streaming_final, so stage1 executes truncation logic (find_next_document_index) meant for incomplete windows; this can truncate the structural index to an earlier boundary and cause the last document in the final chunk to be skipped

Identifies the missing rewind bug in include/simdjson/generic/ondemand/document-inl.h in document::at_pointer where the rewind call is removed, making repeated at_pointer calls order-dependent and returning wrong values or NO_SUCH_FIELD
Identifies the empty input handling regression in src/generic/stage1/json_structural_indexer.h in index where len == 0 returns SUCCESS instead of EMPTY, allowing stage2 to proceed with no structurals
